text_visible: Sometimes people complain, "Another day has passed, but I have accomplished nothing." Or, "The year is almost over, but I have not done a single thing I planned to do at the beginning of the year." We are ambitious when we decide to learn to play the piano, but after a month, we completely forget why we started. We continue spending a lot of time on it not because we enjoy it, but because it has become a habit.

If we had the ability to go back in time, would we change the way we acted and make choices that would leave us more satisfied? If we knew what the future held one day before something happened, would we make different choices and become happier as a result? (Simulating Life Paths with Digital Twins: AI-Generated Future Selves Influence Decision-Making and Expand Human Choice)
